label: Image and text
when: a picture beside a block of text (about us, a service, a feature), the picture on one side and the words on the other
rules: core/media-text, always "mediaType":"image"; the text blocks go in its content div. Use only an image from "The site's media library": its address as src, its ID as "mediaId" in the comment, class="wp-image-<ID> size-full" on the img after alt, its alt text as alt (the example is a placeholder, so no mediaId or class). None in the list: no media-text. Picture on the right: "mediaPosition":"right", class has-media-on-the-right, the content div before the figure. Width not 50: "mediaWidth":N and style="grid-template-columns:N% auto" ("auto N%" on the right) after the class. No other attributes.
example:
Baked every morning

We start at four and the first loaves are out by six, so what you buy is never more than a few hours old.
